## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. For Go changes, run `go test -race ./...`
and `go vet ./...`, format changed files, and include relevant regression coverage.
For documentation-only changes, check links and example commands.

Mention any remaining limitations. For performance changes, include comparable
before/after measurements, the input, and hardware details.
